notes.title: Development Update 9.16.22
notes.notes:
Hello,

September development update with more previews. So, I've made a lot of changes to some core game code. A lot of changes, actually. All the texts should now be typo-free. Punctuations, hyphens, and overall grammar should be a lot better.

I went and removed almost all the original code from the main menu that was included in the template project and coded everything custom so the style is very much unified. For example, the indication of menu tabs is now in the buttons themselves.

I'm positive that almost all game bugs were tackled and fixed.
Every event has a custom unique name, as was voted in the previous poll. Example is "Andrew/Steve Event 5" is now called "Back To The Old Ways" or "Katherine's Event 3" was changed to "Information Broker". Having it like it was before felt a little cheap, not gonna lie. The aim was to describe the event, but also to not give out everything from the name itself. These can change in the future, though.

Another thing implemented is time skip from anywhere you are. I hope this will make the game better. I've wanted to do this for a long time, but have done it only just now. Well, all the critical code was already made before, just the implementation was missing.

Another thing added is a new system for unlocking new pc wallpapers. I'll take or make custom renders from all the new events moving forward and add them as wallpapers. After you complete the event, the wallpaper will be available to set as a background, or right-click will view it full screen.

So far, the changelog has more than 120 entries.

The event is almost finished. It's the longest event that I made up until now from the moment of triggering it to the end spanning over hundreds of renders. It is very long because I needed to kind of speedrun the whole relationship buildup. And also make a coherent story for it. I don't want something like "hey, I'm XXX, let's have sex..." "Alright...".

notes.notes:
Hello,
Another development Update from version 0.19. It's something different in terms of writing, but I really enjoyed it. So far everything is play tested and working, even with the 0.17 saves. There should have been a little more sound effects, but because I haven't heard anything from the person I hired. It'll have to do without it. I've already started planning for the 0.20 version. There're more options I can take. I've settled so far for the Andrew/Steve Event 1 remaster to bring it to the level of detail, writing, and story of the latest events. Then I want to do one Heist Preparation Event. One random minigame/encounter that could lead to a 'happy ending', depending on what you do. And finally, I'd like to do some work on the 'Home' interior, because I want to make a multi-part optional event with Julia. notes.title: Development Update 7.23.22
notes.notes:
Hello,
Another monthly development update. I'm currently approaching a phase of the almost final stages of the update. So there's gonna be a 3 part optional event for Steve, which will feature a whole NFSW event, blowjob, hand job, feet job, vaginal sex, impregnation, etc. Most importantly 60fps animations. I don't know if it's gonna be to everyone's liking, but I'm filling the game world with side content to fill blank spots. There's also going to be a 'secret' event. I don't know if it's going to be accessible because it happens before Julia's divorce event, but also after Andrew/Steve event 5. Well, it's really a secret now, is it? So, tell me how should I make it accessible for you if you've progressed too far in Julia's story. There'll be choices that will make the story richer with hidden details. But it's up to you how you'll handle them.
Here are the preview pictures of the secret event that will open up another follow-up event in the future, depending on if you've done this one. And make the story more rich and clear in the future. You'll also get a chance to beat the shit out of 'Andrew' for breaking Julia's heart in the future planned follow-up.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/xM965t4/as-opt-2-6.jpg[/img]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/2SRZq6n/as-opt-2-13.jpg[/img]

This is a preview of what I've been "researching" from the last year. I've basically created my own lighting procedures to ensure the most realistic experience. It took a lot of time and calculations, but here's the preview of what every Morning/Afternoon event is gonna look like from now on. For the name, I took the inspiration from a GTA mod because it's the most natural lighting I can come up with. I've been struggling with the Morning/Afternoon events lighting. It was very inconsistent from one instance to another, even though it looked somewhat nice. So, I came up with very replicable and the most realistic lighting the "Natural Vision". The preview also features color-corrected textures and shaders. I've been incorporating this workflow for the latest events, but there was no comparison up until now. You can see the shadows and light is almost 100% close to what you'd get if you'd be in the same real-life scenario. The light is more flat and gentle, shadows are diffused exactly as you'd get them in real life (Of course same scenario), overall looking much better. The only drawback is that it's very performance heavy. There'll be a rework of all events that are just too outdated, when hardware will become capable enough.

[url=https://i.ibb.co/SctR7rb/naturalvision-comparision.jpg][img]https://i.ibb.co/SctR7rb/naturalvision-comparision.jpg[/img][/url]

In any case, thank you for playing, thank you for reading this update, and stay tuned for more.
